name: tel-ganesan-platform
description: Tel K. Ganesan executive authority and relationship platform. frontend/ = Next.js website, backend/ = Node.js + Express + MongoDB API.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
